description: List the user's commitments, both what they owe and what others owe them, from meetings, recaps and ones added by hand, up to 20: each with its owner, who the user owes it to, its due date, the meeting it came from and a link to the line where it was said. By default only open ones (not done, not waiting in Review, not a repeat); status all adds done ones and suggestions still waiting in Review, each marked. Filter by a person involved, and by a range of the date recorded or due (dateField due with from/to for what's due this week). For what is owed, either way: get_my_day is one day (the user's promises due by it or undated, and every promise owed to them), list_tasks is every open commitment over any date range or person, and get_recent_commitments is what the last 7 days of meetings promised.

dateField.description: Which date from/to apply to: 'created' (when the task was recorded, the default) or 'due'.

from.description: Earliest date to include: YYYY-MM-DD (the whole day, UTC) or an RFC 3339 time.

person.description: Only tasks involving someone whose name contains this (case-insensitive): the other person, who you owe it to, the task text, or the conversation title.

status.description: Which tasks: 'open' (the default: not done, not waiting in Review, not a repeat; 'pending' is the same), 'completed', or 'all' (also done ones and suggestions still waiting in Review, each marked)

to.description: Latest date to include: YYYY-MM-DD (the whole day, UTC) or an RFC 3339 time.

name: list_tasks
